title: Introducing the FastAPI and Okteto Video Series
summary: Learn how to create a FastAPI app with Okteto remote development environments in this video series by Abdul.
body_markdown:
We have a new series beginning on our YouTube channel where you'll learn how to create a FastAPI app using Okteto remote development environments. Check out the intro video and make sure you've[subscribed to our channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXYaFkiXHdBA7fjKgEgSJfA/) to be the first to know when new videos go live!
